questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about the electronic spectra of conjugated dyes?

answers.a: The position of the absorption bands is not affected by the length of the conjugated system
answers.b: The intensity of the absorption bands is not affected by the concentration of the dye in solution.
answers.c: The electronic spectra cannot be used to determine the concentration of the dye in solution
answers.d: The molar extinction coefficient can be calculated from the electronic spectra

questions.question: In the Free Electron Model, what is the effect of increasing the number of electrons in the conjugated system?

answers.b: The absorption bands shift to longer wavelengths.
answers.c: The absorption bands will not change.
answers.d: More vibrational fine structure will appear in the absorption band.
